Remark
[Positive bisectional curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0222 ↗ prop:system-strong-maximum-principle-positive-definite 1. ch12:12.55\group Ricci Flow Applications

For a Kähler--Ricci flow on a connected manifold without boundary, nonnegative bisectional curvature everywhere and positive bisectional curvature somewhere at time zero imply positive bisectional curvature everywhere for every positive time.
